record.question: The punishment for allowing premises to be used for the commission of an offence is:
options: imprisonment for a term of not less than three months which may extend to one year, or with fine of not less than two thousand rupees which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both;
imprisonment for a term of not less than three months which may extend to two years, or with fine of not less than two thousand rupees which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both;
imprisonment for a term of not less than three months which may extend to three years, or with fine of not less than two thousand rupees which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both;
imprisonment for a term of not less than three months which may extend to four years, or with fine of not less than two thousand rupees which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both;
record.explanation: Allowing premises to be used for an offence carries three months to one year imprisonment.
